title: junellia aspera var. longidentata
intro: Junellia aspera var. longidentata, commonly known as "Huaico", is a plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in South America, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Junellia aspera var. longidentata include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and prevent oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
